scripts.verify:phase-a: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm audit --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --audit-level=high && npm run build:pages
scripts.build:pages: wrangler deploy --dry-run -c wrangler.worker.jsonc --outdir pages-bundle && node scripts/copy-pages-bundle.mjs
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run typecheck && npm run build:pages && wrangler pages deploy --branch main
